ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with a high contrast ratio against localized high-intensity (white/tan) clusters at the lateral tips and sparse white flecks; estimated dark-to-light ratio of 85:15.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe is characterized by a contiguous solid dark-intensity block. Right lobe contains a non-contiguous distribution of high-intensity white flecks primarily in the upper-medial and distal regions. High-intensity tan/white clusters are localized at the far-left and far-right distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible narrow V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 40 degrees, partially obscured at the vertex by water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the medial trailing edge of both lobes, transitioning to high-frequency, high-amplitude irregular jaggedness at the lateral tips due to external biological growth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a moderately concave curvature from the median notch to the lateral tips, with the right lobe showing a more pronounced upward sweep relative to the horizontal axis.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-contrast clusters of white/tan pixels (barnacle colonies) located at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes; secondary smaller circular white flecks scattered across the mid-region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, vertically-oriented white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the medial-to-distal surface of the right lobe; sparse, shorter diagonal linear marks on the left lobe medial surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustations at the lateral lobe tips creating significant alteration of the natural geometric edge.
